content.value_statement: Keeping Longbridge watchlists, alerts, and sharelists current can require repeated CLI lookups and careful account changes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through confirmed Longbridge CLI workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists Longbridge watchlist groups and helps manage group names and symbols.
Creates, renames, deletes, and updates watchlist groups after explicit confirmation.
Lists, creates, enables, disables, and deletes Longbridge price alerts.
Browses popular community sharelists and opens list details with constituent stocks.
Creates and updates sharelists after the user confirms the planned change.
Matches responses to English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese user input.
limitations: Requires Longbridge CLI or an MCP fallback, plus account login for private data.
Does not place trades, submit orders, or manage positions.
Mutating actions require a separate explicit confirmation before execution.
Results depend on Longbridge permissions, CLI availability, and current command flags.

use_cases.title: Maintain Watchlist Groups
use_cases.description: Keep sector or strategy groups current without remembering every Longbridge command.

use_cases.title: Manage Price Alerts
use_cases.description: Set, review, enable, disable, or remove price alerts after checking the target and direction.

use_cases.title: Curate Community Lists
use_cases.description: Browse public sharelists, inspect constituents, and maintain curated lists for subscribers.

prompt_templates.title: List Watchlists
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Longbridge watchlist groups and summarize the group names and symbol counts.

prompt_templates.title: Add Symbols Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Add NVDA.US and AAPL.US to my Tech watchlist group. Preview the change and wait for my confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Create Price Alert
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Longbridge price alert for TSLA.US at 250 USD when the price falls. Ask me to confirm before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Review Sharelist Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Open my Longbridge sharelist 12345, show its constituents, then prepare a confirmed change that adds 700.HK and removes TSLA.US.

output_examples.output: Watchlist groups found: Tech, Dividend, and HK Growth. Tech contains 12 symbols, Dividend contains 8, and HK Growth contains 15.

output_examples.input: Add AAPL.US to my Tech group.
output_examples.output: About to add AAPL.US to Tech. No command will run until you confirm with yes or confirm.
Popular sharelists include AI Leaders, HK Blue Chips, and Dividend Ideas. I can open any list if you provide its ID.

best_practices: Use exact symbols in CODE.MARKET format when possible.
Review the preview carefully before confirming any account change.
List groups or alerts first when names or identifiers are uncertain.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for watchlist, alert, or sharelist mutations without reviewing the preview.
Do not use vague requests when a specific action, group, symbol, or price is required.
Do not expect trade execution, portfolio management, or investment advice.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It manages watchlists, alerts, and sharelists only.

faq.question: Do I need a Longbridge account?
faq.answer: Yes for private watchlists, alerts, and write actions. Public sharelist browsing may not require login.

faq.question: Why does it ask for confirmation?
faq.answer: Confirmation prevents unintended changes to persistent Longbridge account data.

faq.question: Can it use Chinese prompts?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese responses.

faq.question: What tools must be installed?
faq.answer: The Longbridge CLI should be installed. An MCP fallback may work when available.

faq.question: Can it manage community lists?
faq.answer: Yes. It can browse, inspect, create, update, sort, and delete sharelists after confirmation.
